KŌMA Studio

Primary site: https://koma-studio.site
Source repository: https://github.com/klaus-2/koma-studio
License: MIT — https://github.com/klaus-2/koma-studio/blob/main/LICENSE
Public app/chat: https://chat.koma-studio.site
Community: https://discord.gg/tzaV2efD4e

What KŌMA Studio is:
KŌMA Studio is free and open-source (MIT) scanlation software for manga, manhwa, and comics.
It is a self-hostable desktop application that combines translation, cleanup, redraw,
typesetting, and QA into a chapter-scale workflow.

Licensing and deployment facts:
- License: MIT. Commercial use, modification, forking and redistribution are allowed.
- Cost: free. No paid tier, no credits, no seats, no paywalled features.
- Hosting: runs locally on the user's machine; no account and no license server.
- Telemetry: none. Pages and projects stay on the user's disk.
- AI models: bring your own — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint,
  including a local model. Nothing is hard-wired to a single vendor.
- Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux (and buildable from source).
